description: Commanded the three nights from Somerset House, and refused the king.
name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon

description: Set three nights down as promised, with nothing received.
name: John Heminges

description: Heard the ban on the king, and did not guess the heel.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Named yesterday's justice, and refused to choose the old play.
name: William Shakespeare
